name: <kebab-case>
label: <Role family>
_note: Copy to packs/<name>.json and fill in. See engine/packs.py for every field.

titles._no_range_note: What to do with a posting that shows no pay range: include_if_level_fits (keep only titles matching 'senior'; the default), include (keep regardless; use it for fields whose titles carry no level word, like Registered Nurse or Math Teacher), or exclude (drop every no-range posting). Empty means use config salary.no_range_policy.

triage._note: Regex for 'asks you to manage managers' in a posting. Empty keeps the built-in product-management pattern (engine/triage.py MANAGERS_RE); set one with your field's wording.

sources._note: Built In and remote100k search by category. builtin_path is a Built In path such as /jobs/remote/nursing (a string or list); remote100k_category is a remote100k category such as healthcare. Config sources.builtin.opts.paths and sources.remote100k.opts.categories win. A pack that sets neither skips those two boards (only product-management has built-in defaults).
